{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Cuisine of Israel|Cuisine of Israel]] | [[Cookbook:Sandwiches|Sandwiches]]

The '''bagel toast''' is a modern Israeli snack. A good bagel toast has a crispy outside, and is not mushy.

==Ingredients==
* 1 or more slices of [[Cookbook:Bagel|bagel]] with [[Cookbook:Sesame Seed|sesame seeds]], sized to fit your grill
* Brindsah [[Cookbook:Cheese|cheese]] (or [[Cookbook:Feta Cheese|feta cheese]])
* [[Cookbook:Slicing|Sliced]] hard cheese
* Sliced [[Cookbook:Green Olive|green olives]]
* [[Cookbook:Corn|Corn]]
* 1 sliced [[Cookbook:Tomato|tomato]]
* 1 sliced [[Cookbook:Onion|onion]]
* [[Cookbook:Ketchup|Ketchup]]
* [[Cookbook:Thousand Island Dressing|Thousand Island dressing]]

==Procedure==
# Cut the bagel in half.
# Spread the Brindsah cheese (or the Feta cheese) on the half bagel.
# Cover with several slices of hard cheese.
# Add the corn and the sliced green olives.
# Add several tomato slices and onion slices.
# Pour ketchup and Thousand Island dressing on top.
# Cover the bagel with the other half of the bagel.
# Pour more Thousand Island dressing on top of the bagel and put it onto the [[Cookbook:Grill|grill]].
# Activate the grill. 
# Remove the bagel when all the cheese has melted and the outside is medium-dark brown and crispy, about 2 minutes.
# Eat immediately, served with any combination of sliced tomatoes, sliced cucumber, and/or [[Cookbook:Pickle|pickles]].

==Notes, tips, and variations==

* Other toppings which could be used include [[Cookbook:Mushroom|mushrooms]], [[Cookbook:Cream Cheese|cream cheese]], and [[Cookbook:Hot Sauce|hot sauce]].
